On Tue, May 11, 2027 at 11:04 AM PDT Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I've attached our intake checklist and a very small diagram of the claim escalation path.

Adding some field-level color:
- If the buyer PO is issued by a US corporate billing entity, priority goes to the seller who holds the US contract relationship.
- If Contoso's technical lead is EMEA but purchasing is in US, we treat the US AE as primary for claim unless a seller consent form (from MSFT Partner Center) explicitly assigns ownership to the EMEA AE.
- Where historical claims exist (past 12 months) we treat that as the default owner unless a change request is filed via the Partner Center ticketing route.

For escalation: Karthik, please open a PC arbitration ticket if both parties claim — include the HubSpot deal link and Contoso snapshot. MSFT typically responds within 48 hours for arbitration with a provisional owner while they run a deeper audit.

I'll be on the call tomorrow and can bring the field roster and consent audit.

—Vanessa
Senior Partner Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
